program.source: export function evaluate({ inputs, time, seed, state }) { const launchSpeed = inputs.launchSpeed; const gravity = 9.8; const t = time; const height = launchSpeed * t - (gravity * t * t) / 2; const velocity = launchSpeed - gravity * t; const apexTime = launchSpeed / gravity; const apexHeight = (launchSpeed * launchSpeed) / (2 * gravity); const maxH = Math.max(2.5, (5 * 5) / (2 * 9.8) * 1.2); const ballY = 320 - (height / maxH) * 220; const ballX = 320; let motionState = "Moving up"; if (Math.abs(velocity) < 0.05) { motionState = "Still for an instant"; } else if (velocity < 0) { motionState = "Moving down"; } const gravityState = "Gravity pulls down"; const lane = sdk.panel({ x: 40, y: 40, w: 560, h: 360, title: "The ball stops rising. Gravity doesn’t stop.", state: "Time: " + sdk.format(t, 2) + " s" }); const axis = sdk.axis("axis.height", { x: 120, y: 360, length: 240, orientation: "y", min: 0, max: Math.ceil(maxH * 10) / 10, ticks: [0, Math.round(maxH/2*10)/10, Math.ceil(maxH*10)/10], label: "Height", unit: "m" }); const ball = sdk.circle("ball.toss", ballX, ballY, 28, { role: "output" }); const ground = sdk.groundMark("ground.mark", ballX, 360, 60, "Launch"); let vVec = []; if (Math.abs(velocity) >= 0.05) { vVec = sdk.vector("vec.v", { x: ballX + 25, y: ballY }, { value: Math.abs(velocity), direction: velocity > 0 ? "up" : "down" }, { scale: 15, minLength: 12, label: "v" }); } const aVec = sdk.vector("vec.a", { x: ballX - 25, y: ballY }, { value: gravity, direction: "down" }, { scale: 15, minLength: 12, label: "g" }); const callout = sdk.callout(ballX + 45, ballY - 20, [motionState, gravityState], { id: "callout.toss", role: "output" }); return { frame: { width: 640, height: 420, objects: [lane, axis, ground, ball, ...vVec, ...aVec, callout], readouts: [{ id: "motionState", value: motionState }, { id: "gravityState", value: gravityState }] }, quantities: { launchSpeed: launchSpeed, gravity: gravity, apexTime: apexTime, apexHeight: apexHeight, velocity: velocity, height: height } }; }

manifest.title: The ball stops rising. Gravity doesn’t stop.
manifest.summary: Gravity slows the ball on the way up and speeds it up on the way down. At the top, the ball is still for an instant while gravity pulls it downward.
manifest.description: A vertical height scale shows a ball tossed upwards. A blue velocity vector shortens, disappears at the apex, and points downward during descent. A dashed downward acceleration vector remains constant throughout.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed, then press Play. At the top, playback pauses so you can inspect the arrows.
